events.summary: The leonin split into two prides after losing their leader Raksha: one supports the regent kha, the other rebels.
events.quote: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides: one side supported the regent kha, while the other rebelled in fury.

events.summary: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crests over Taj-Nar, bringing hope to survivors.
events.quote: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

events.summary: At O-Kagachi's behest the Kami War begins to regain That Which Was Taken.
events.quote: At his behest the Kami War began to regain That Which Was Taken.

events.summary: Ugin's summons leads Sarkhan Vol to the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas that seals Tarkir's fate.
events.quote: Ugin's whispered summons led Sarkhan Vol to the moment that would echo down the centuries and seal Tarkir's fate: the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Lady Azami recommends proceeding with the plan to destroy all kami shrines.
events.quote: I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami.

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi, and Jace questions how that worked last time.
events.quote: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."

events.summary: Alovnek declares he will have justice now rather than await the arbiters.
events.quote: But I will have justice now.

events.summary: Garruk tells Liliana Vess he will hunt her down on the dark plane.
events.quote: I have taken down countless night hunters and this dark plane is not big enough for you to hide.

events.summary: Nissa Revane asks to be shown how to help Zendikar.
events.quote: "I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."

events.summary: As the Eldrazi spread, Zendikar's defenders seek any secret that could give them an advantage.
events.quote: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

relations.note: Ajani calls Jazal his kha and his brother
relations.quote: As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations.

relations.note: Some believe Raksha is Dakan's reincarnation
relations.quote: Some believe that Raksha, youngest of the kha, is the reincarnation of Dakan, the first and mightiest of leonin leaders.

relations.note: Once a foe, she became one of Madara's greatest protectors
relations.quote: Once a fierce foe, she would become one of Madara's greatest protectors.
